motion_rule: T-Rex travels with his whole bulk every beat, never reaching from a standing pose; the pterodactyl works huge at the lens in his speech beats; the tiny arms fall short
camera_moves: low angle, camera always moving, new framing every beat: push, arc, orbit, whip with the dragged meat, low push on the charge, creep to his snout at the end
character: grumpy old T-Rex, wrinkled hide, enormous head, tiny front arms
cast: one T-Rex, one pterodactyl vendor huge at the lens; nobody else
props: ONE flat stone slab on the ground as the counter, one level; wooden price board, one big numeral 500, no letters; one slab of meat on the stone 4.85, dragged along it 5.6-8.4, torn away 8.4
environment: clear noon, riverside meadow, short grass; dust low
lighting: blazing noon sun overhead, bright throughout, hard crisp shadows, rim light on his back

audio.delivery: gravelly old male voice, steady 4.5 syllables per second, never hurried
audio.pronunciation: natural native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window, no pause where a phrase spans two windows, silence in wordless beats
audio.lip_sync: jaw works each syllable, mouth free of props while he speaks, voice always from the T-Rex
audio.sfx: board clatter 0.0,2.5;meat slap 4.85;meat scraping stone 5.6-8.4;wing slap and jaw clack 8.4;stone grind, board thwack 9.1

timeline.a: he headbutts the board on the stone, it flips a body length up and slaps back down
his head snaps up off the stone, torso rocking back on his heels
he stomps a full stride at the board, whole bulk lurching in, stone shuddering under his foot
he swings head and chest across the stone, a tiny arm churning air short of the board
he overshoots, staggers sideways; pterodactyl huge at the lens shoves the board into his cheek
he turns his whole bulk to camera, head leading; pterodactyl knocked spinning off him, board clattering back
the tail whips round and sweeps the board off the stone, it tumbles to the ground
he treads the board into the dirt; pterodactyl huge at the lens slaps the slab of meat down on the stone
pterodactyl huge at the lens hauls the meat scraping down the stone; he heaves his whole bulk after it, arms churning short
he hurls himself sideways along the stone, hind legs pounding, tail sweeping the grass, pterodactyl beating wings huge at the lens
he charges the last stretch of the stone, hind legs driving, the slab shunting under him, pterodactyl hauling the meat ahead of his snout
he throws his head down after it, jaws snapping shut on the meat as the last word lands
pterodactyl rips the meat from his jaws, wing-slaps his snout and bolts out of frame; his head jerks after it, jaws clacking air
he shoves the stone with his snout, it grinds round; the pinned board springs from under his foot onto his nose and slides to his eye as he rears back

must_appear: T-Rex moving his whole bulk every beat; arms shorter than his head; ONE stone slab; board, numeral 500; meat on the stone 4.85-8.4; pterodactyl huge at the lens
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dim light, dark scene, human hands, second dinosaur, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, slow motion, slow speech, static camera, T-Rex standing still, reaching without moving his feet, floating props, pterodactyl small in the background, accented Russian
